theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the only scorable top subject combining eligible trend-gate status, high durability_bar (0.62), and genuinely broad breadth (0.636) — the widest participation among the leaders. Rank #2 and challenger to AI Infrastructure, but unlike the headliner its trend is not relying on one or two names. Crowding_z 0.93 is elevated but below the crowded flag, so it is a lean, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership may just be a carry/defensive bid in an unscheduled-surprise-heavy macro tape (unscheduled_share 0.75); mixed Hurst tag means the trend lacks internal persistence and could mean-revert quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE gives up its 20-day relative lead versus SPY while breadth (0.636) compresses below ~0.4 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
